//: The loan desk's policy: what Arcade's contextual access hooks enforce on every LoanDesk tool call, whoever makes it and whatever the model was told. The gate reads this file at start; restart `uv run gate` after an edit.

Tool names are the PascalCase names Arcade puts in hook payloads (ApproveLoan, not approve_loan). A rule naming a tool that does not exist is refused at load, because a rule that matches nothing is indistinguishable from a rule that permits.
Who someone is (role, clearance) is not here: it is in the graph, on the Officer nodes, so `uv run officers set-clearance` changes what this policy allows on the next call.

Rules for one hook run in file order and the first pre rule that matches decides. A rule with `escalate` can be satisfied by a single-use approval: an approved request for exactly that action, resource and amount, made by the caller and decided by someone else.
`reason` is what the agent reads when a call is refused, so it is written for a model: it names the exact tool to call next, by the name in the agent's tool list (LoanDesk_RequestApproval).

rules.description: A credit analyst never sees the tools that decide a loan: they are absent from the tool list, not merely refused.
rules.reason: Credit analysts do not hold approval authority; the decision tools are hidden from this role.

rules.description: An approval above the caller's authority is refused, and the refusal tells the model how to escalate and then retry.
rules.reason: DENIED: approving {{loan_id}} for {{amount}} exceeds your approval authority of {{clearance}}. To proceed, call LoanDesk_RequestApproval with action=approve_loan, resource_id={{loan_id}}, amount={{amount}} and justification=<why this loan should be approved>, then wait for the approval and retry LoanDesk_ApproveLoan with loan_id={{loan_id}} and amount={{amount}} unchanged.

rules.description: Only a pending approval request can be decided.
rules.reason: DENIED: {{request_id}} is not a pending approval request.

rules.description: Nobody approves their own request, however they got the request id.
rules.reason: DENIED: you asked for {{request_id}} yourself, so you cannot decide it. It is with {{routed_to}}.

rules.description: An approver needs the authority the request covers.
rules.reason: DENIED: {{request_id}} is for {{request_amount}}, above your approval authority of {{clearance}}.
